assets.spoken_text: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.
assets.context_and_editorial_notes: Primary letter facsimile visually inspected; ye expanded to the, sholders modernised to shoulders. Optical correspondence; metaphor predates Newton.

assets.spoken_text: Truth is ever to be found in simplicity, and not in the multiplicity and confusion of things.
assets.context_and_editorial_notes: Ampersands expanded to and. Biblical-prophecy interpretation, not a Principia quotation.

assets.spoken_text: Nature is pleased with simplicity, and affects not the pomp of superfluous causes.
assets.source_location: Principia,Book III,Rule I; Motte translation, 1846 edition
assets.context_and_editorial_notes: Historical English translation; exact clause excerpt, not original English authored by Newton.
Exact translated clause excerpt, terminal punctuation supplied. Unknown cause/mechanism of gravity, not rejection of scientific hypotheses generally.

assets.spoken_text: For the rays to speak properly are not coloured.
assets.context_and_editorial_notes: Newton own English. Colour sensation versus rays disposition to excite that sensation.

assets.spoken_text: That it should be so is very reasonable, Nature being ever conformable to her self; but an experimental Proof is desired.
assets.source_location: Opticks 1718,Book I Part I,Proposition VI discussion,p. 66
assets.context_and_editorial_notes: Newton own English. Expected regularity in refraction still requires experimental confirmation.
